# Unknown provider name causes hard error

build_provider raises LLMProviderError for any provider name other than the supported set ('anthropic', 'openai', 'azure-openai'), causing configuration errors to surface as exceptions.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/provider.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.provider.build_provider`
